- **Troubleshooting in Manager:** the Services page has a new Troubleshooting card. Check connections tests Docker, the database, machine learning, network discovery, the internet, your server's clock and free space, and says plainly what's wrong. Download report saves one file with the last day of logs from every part of Frameleaf and the problems Manager spotted, with passwords, folder paths, file names and e-mail addresses taken out, ready to attach to a post in Community › Bug reports.
- **Complete logs:** the service logs in Manager now include the error output Frameleaf's services print, so database messages no longer go missing.
- **Your computers in one place:** the Computers page now shows the Frameleaf Desktop helpers on your other computers.
- **Smoother imports:** resuming an import after Frameleaf has started no longer checks your original app again.
- **Security updates:** updated components with known security fixes.
